```{r setup, include=FALSE}
figure_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "nma-report-4-figures")
```

# Read the two databases

The empirical samples are the 300 incidence matrices prepared by
`empirical_database.Rmd`. By default, this report loads the supplied
old-database incidence matrices. Set `rebuild_old_database <- TRUE` in the
setup chunk to reconstruct them from the included Excel workbooks using the
extraction table and exclusion logic below.

```{r read-databases}
empirical_networks <- readRDS(empirical_network_file)
if (is.null(names(empirical_networks))) {
  names(empirical_networks) <- paste0("empirical-", seq_along(empirical_networks))
}

if (!rebuild_old_database && old_network_cache_available) {
  old_networks <- readRDS(old_network_cache_file)
  old_processing <- readRDS(old_processing_cache_file)
  excluded_old_ids <- old_processing$excluded_old_ids
  old_files_not_processed <- old_processing$old_files_not_processed
  old_network_source <- "Saved cache"
} else {
  # Rebuild incidence matrices with the project's shared conversion function.
  source(data_processing_file)

  old_files <- list.files(
    old_data_dir,
    pattern = "^[0-9]+_dataset\\.xlsx$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  old_ids <- as.integer(sub("_dataset\\.xlsx$", "", basename(old_files)))
  old_files <- old_files[order(old_ids)]
  old_ids <- sort(old_ids)
  if (length(old_files) == 0L) stop("No old-database workbooks were found.")

  extraction <- readxl::read_excel(extraction_file) |>
    transmute(
      RecordID_clean = str_trim(str_remove(
        as.character(RecordID), "\\s*\\(.*\\)\\s*"
      )),
      Include = str_trim(toupper(as.character(Include)))
    )

  excluded_old_ids <- extraction |>
    filter(
      RecordID_clean %in% paste0("570-", old_ids),
      Include == "N"
    ) |>
    distinct(RecordID_clean) |>
    mutate(old_id = as.integer(str_remove(RecordID_clean, "^570-"))) |>
    pull(old_id)

  old_networks <- list()
  old_files_not_processed <- character()
  for (file_i in old_files) {
    old_id <- as.integer(sub("_dataset\\.xlsx$", "", basename(file_i)))
    if (old_id %in% excluded_old_ids) next

    raw_data <- tryCatch(
      suppressMessages(readxl::read_excel(file_i)),
      error = function(error) error
    )
    if (inherits(raw_data, "error")) {
      old_files_not_processed <- c(old_files_not_processed, as.character(old_id))
      next
    }

    B <- tryCatch(
      suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(create_edge_list(raw_data))),
      error = function(error) error
    )
    if (
      inherits(B, "error") || is.null(B) || !is.matrix(B) ||
        nrow(B) == 0L || ncol(B) == 0L
    ) {
      old_files_not_processed <- c(old_files_not_processed, as.character(old_id))
      next
    }
    old_networks[[as.character(old_id)]] <- B
  }
  if (length(old_networks) == 0L) {
    stop("No valid old-database networks were reconstructed.")
  }

  saveRDS(old_networks, old_network_cache_file)
  saveRDS(
    list(
      excluded_old_ids = excluded_old_ids,
      old_files_not_processed = old_files_not_processed
    ),
    old_processing_cache_file
  )
  old_network_source <- "Raw workbooks (cache created)"
}

database_processing <- tibble(
  Data = c("2023 Sample", "2000-2019 Database"),
  `Networks included` = c(length(empirical_networks), length(old_networks)),
  `Raw files excluded` = c(NA_integer_, length(excluded_old_ids)),
  `Raw files not processed` = c(NA_integer_, length(old_files_not_processed)),
  Source = c("Saved empirical incidence file", old_network_source)
)
knitr::kable(database_processing, caption = "Database processing counts")
```

# Compute comparable results

The empirical metrics are computed with `metric_functions.R`. Old-database
metrics are computed with the same functions on the first run and saved for
reuse. No metric columns from the old database's pre-existing summary report
are used.

```{r compute-results}
empirical_metrics <- compute_metrics_for_networks(empirical_networks)
empirical_edge_multiplicity <- compute_edge_multiplicity_for_networks(empirical_networks)

compute_degrees <- function(networks) {
  rows <- lapply(seq_along(networks), function(i) {
    B <- 1L * (as.matrix(networks[[i]]) != 0)
    B <- B[rowSums(B) >= 2L, , drop = FALSE]
    B <- B[, colSums(B) > 0L, drop = FALSE]
    projection <- crossprod(B)
    diag(projection) <- 0
    graph <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(
      1L * (projection > 0), mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE
    )
    list(
      unipartite = tibble(
        network_id = names(networks)[i], degree = as.integer(degree(graph))
      ),
      trial = tibble(
        network_id = names(networks)[i], degree = as.integer(rowSums(B))
      ),
      treatment = tibble(
        network_id = names(networks)[i], degree = as.integer(colSums(B))
      )
    )
  })
  aggregate_degree <- function(type) {
    bind_rows(lapply(rows, `[[`, type)) |>
      filter(degree > 0) |>
      count(degree, name = "count")
  }
  list(
    unipartite = aggregate_degree("unipartite"),
    trial = aggregate_degree("trial"),
    treatment = aggregate_degree("treatment")
  )
}

empirical_degrees <- compute_degrees(empirical_networks)

old_derived_cache_available <- all(file.exists(c(
  old_metrics_cache_file,
  old_edge_cache_file,
  old_degrees_cache_file
)))
if (!rebuild_old_database && old_derived_cache_available) {
  old_metrics <- readRDS(old_metrics_cache_file)
  old_edge_multiplicity <- readRDS(old_edge_cache_file)
  old_degrees <- readRDS(old_degrees_cache_file)
} else {
  old_metrics <- compute_metrics_for_networks(old_networks)
  old_edge_multiplicity <- compute_edge_multiplicity_for_networks(old_networks)
  old_degrees <- compute_degrees(old_networks)
  saveRDS(old_metrics, old_metrics_cache_file)
  saveRDS(old_edge_multiplicity, old_edge_cache_file)
  saveRDS(old_degrees, old_degrees_cache_file)
}

# Older saved metric tables lack this column. Count edges in the same filtered
# bipartite incidence matrices used by compute_metrics_for_networks().
old_metrics$number_of_arms <- vapply(
  old_networks[old_metrics$network_id],
  function(network) {
    B <- 1L * (as.matrix(network) != 0)
    B <- B[rowSums(B) >= 2L, , drop = FALSE]
    B <- B[, colSums(B) > 0L, drop = FALSE]
    as.integer(sum(B))
  },
  integer(1)
)

comparison_data <- bind_rows(
  old_metrics |> mutate(Data = "2000-2019 Database"),
  empirical_metrics |> mutate(Data = "2023 Sample")
) |>
  mutate(Data = factor(Data, levels = names(comparison_colors)))

fit_shifted_geometric <- function(degree_counts) {
  degree_counts <- degree_counts |>
    filter(is.finite(degree), is.finite(count), degree >= 2, count > 0)
  values <- rep(degree_counts$degree, degree_counts$count)
  k_min <- min(values)
  p <- 1 / (mean(values - k_min) + 1)
  theta <- 1 - p
  line <- tibble(degree = seq.int(k_min, max(values))) |>
    mutate(count = length(values) * p * theta^(degree - k_min))
  list(theta = theta, p = p, k_min = k_min, n = length(values), line = line)
}

empirical_trial_fit <- fit_shifted_geometric(empirical_degrees$trial)
if (!rebuild_old_database && file.exists(old_trial_fit_cache_file)) {
  old_trial_fit <- readRDS(old_trial_fit_cache_file)
} else {
  old_trial_fit <- fit_shifted_geometric(old_degrees$trial)
  saveRDS(old_trial_fit, old_trial_fit_cache_file)
}
```

```{r plot-and-fit-helpers, include=FALSE}
metric_numerics <- function(metric) {
  comparison_data |>
    filter(is.finite(.data[[metric]])) |>
    group_by(Data) |>
    summarise(
      Networks = n(), Minimum = min(.data[[metric]]),
      Mean = mean(.data[[metric]]), Maximum = max(.data[[metric]]),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

fit_parameters <- function(
  data, response, predictors, log_y = FALSE, relationship = NULL
) {
  predictor_labels <- names(predictors)
  if (is.null(predictor_labels) || any(predictor_labels == "")) {
    predictor_labels <- predictors
  }
  bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(predictors), function(i) {
    predictor <- unname(predictors[i])
    model_data <- data |>
      filter(
        is.finite(.data[[response]]), is.finite(.data[[predictor]]),
        .data[[predictor]] > 0
      )
    if (log_y) {
      model_data <- model_data |> filter(.data[[response]] > 0)
    }
    model_data |>
      group_by(Data) |>
      group_modify(function(group_data, key) {
        x_fit <- log10(group_data[[predictor]])
        y_fit <- if (log_y) log10(group_data[[response]]) else group_data[[response]]
        model <- lm(y_fit ~ x_fit)
        tibble(
          Relationship = relationship %||% response,
          `X-axis` = predictor_labels[i],
          `Y-axis` = if (log_y) paste0("log10(", response, ")") else response,
          Slope = unname(coef(model)[2]),
          Intercept = unname(coef(model)[1]),
          `R-squared` = summary(model)$r.squared,
          Observations = nrow(group_data)
        )
      }) |>
      ungroup()
  }))
}

`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x

show_parameters <- function(parameters, caption = "Fitted-line parameters") {
  knitr::kable(parameters, digits = 3, caption = caption)
}

metric_histogram <- function(metric, label, binwidth, boundary = 0) {
  ggplot() +
    geom_histogram(
      data = filter(comparison_data, Data == "2000-2019 Database", is.finite(.data[[metric]])),
      aes(x = .data[[metric]], fill = Data),
      colour = "grey15", linewidth = 0.25, alpha = comparison_alpha[["2000-2019 Database"]],
      binwidth = binwidth, boundary = boundary, position = "identity"
    ) +
    geom_histogram(
      data = filter(comparison_data, Data == "2023 Sample", is.finite(.data[[metric]])),
      aes(x = .data[[metric]], fill = Data),
      colour = "grey15", linewidth = 0.25, alpha = comparison_alpha[["2023 Sample"]],
      binwidth = binwidth, boundary = boundary, position = "identity"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = comparison_colors, name = "Data") +
    labs(x = label, y = "Number of networks")
}

metric_scatter <- function(
  metric, predictor, metric_label, predictor_label,
  log_y = FALSE, fitted_line = TRUE
) {
  plot_data <- comparison_data |>
    filter(
      is.finite(.data[[metric]]), is.finite(.data[[predictor]]),
      .data[[predictor]] > 0
    )
  if (log_y) plot_data <- plot_data |> filter(.data[[metric]] > 0)

  plot <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(x = .data[[predictor]], y = .data[[metric]], fill = Data, colour = Data)
  ) +
    geom_count(
      aes(size = after_stat(n)), shape = 21, colour = "grey15",
      stroke = 0.35, alpha = 0.75
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = comparison_colors, name = "Data") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = comparison_colors, guide = "none") +
    scale_size_area(max_size = 8, name = "Count") +
    scale_x_log10(labels = plain_log_labels) +
    labs(x = predictor_label, y = metric_label)
  if (fitted_line) {
    plot <- plot + geom_smooth(
      aes(colour = Data), method = "lm", formula = y ~ x,
      se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE
    )
  }
  if (log_y) plot <- plot + scale_y_log10(labels = plain_log_labels)
  plot
}

make_metric_figure <- function(
  metric, label, binwidth, bipartite, log_y,
  fitted_line = TRUE, histogram_boundary = 0
) {
  histogram <- metric_histogram(
    metric, label, binwidth, boundary = histogram_boundary
  ) + labs(title = "(a)")
  versus_N <- metric_scatter(
    metric, "N_treatments", label, "Number of treatments",
    log_y = log_y, fitted_line = fitted_line
  ) + labs(title = "(b)")
  if (!bipartite) {
    return(histogram + versus_N + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.18)))
  }
  versus_M <- metric_scatter(
    metric, "N_total_trials", label, "Number of trials",
    log_y = log_y, fitted_line = fitted_line
  ) + labs(title = "(c)")
  histogram + versus_N + versus_M + plot_layout(nrow = 1, guides = "collect")
}

metric_parameters <- function(metric, bipartite, log_y, label) {
  predictors <- c("Number of treatments" = "N_treatments")
  if (bipartite) predictors <- c(predictors, "Number of trials" = "N_total_trials")
  fit_parameters(comparison_data, metric, predictors, log_y, label)
}
```

# Degree-distribution comparison

Panel (b) contains separate maximum-likelihood shifted-geometric fits. Panels
(a) and (c) contain no fitted lines.

```{r degree-distribution-comparison, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
degree_comparison <- function(empirical_counts, old_counts) {
  bind_rows(
    old_counts |> mutate(Data = "2000-2019 Database"),
    empirical_counts |> mutate(Data = "2023 Sample")
  ) |>
    filter(is.finite(degree), is.finite(count), degree > 0, count > 0) |>
    mutate(Data = factor(Data, levels = names(comparison_colors)))
}

degree_unipartite <- degree_comparison(empirical_degrees$unipartite, old_degrees$unipartite)
degree_trial <- degree_comparison(empirical_degrees$trial, old_degrees$trial) |>
  filter(degree >= 2)
degree_treatment <- degree_comparison(empirical_degrees$treatment, old_degrees$treatment)

degree_point_plot <- function(data, x_label, y_label, title) {
  ggplot(data, aes(degree, count, colour = Data)) +
    geom_point(size = 1.8) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = comparison_colors, name = "Data") +
    scale_x_log10(labels = plain_log_labels) +
    scale_y_log10(labels = plain_log_labels) +
    labs(title = title, x = x_label, y = y_label)
}

p_degree_unipartite <- degree_point_plot(
  degree_unipartite, x_label_unipartite_degree, "Number of treatments", "(a)"
)

trial_fit_lines <- bind_rows(
  old_trial_fit$line |> mutate(Data = "2000-2019 Database"),
  empirical_trial_fit$line |> mutate(Data = "2023 Sample")
) |>
  mutate(Data = factor(Data, levels = names(comparison_colors)))

p_degree_trial <- ggplot(degree_trial, aes(degree, count, colour = Data, fill = Data)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", alpha = 0.65) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), size = 1.8) +
  geom_line(
    data = trial_fit_lines,
    aes(degree, count, colour = Data, group = Data),
    linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = degree_fit_colors, name = "Data") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = comparison_colors, name = "Data") +
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = 10^(-1:4),
    labels = function(x) ifelse(x == 0.1, "0", plain_log_labels(x))
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.1, 10000)) +
  labs(title = "(b)", x = x_label_bipartite_trial_degree, y = "Number of trials")

p_degree_treatment <- degree_point_plot(
  degree_treatment, x_label_bipartite_treatment_degree, "Number of treatments", "(c)"
)

p_degree_comparison <- p_degree_unipartite + p_degree_trial + p_degree_treatment +
  plot_layout(nrow = 1, guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
p_degree_comparison

degree_fit_parameters <- tibble(
  Data = factor(c("2000-2019 Database", "2023 Sample"), levels = names(comparison_colors)),
  theta = c(old_trial_fit$theta, empirical_trial_fit$theta),
  p = c(old_trial_fit$p, empirical_trial_fit$p),
  `Minimum degree` = c(old_trial_fit$k_min, empirical_trial_fit$k_min),
  Observations = c(old_trial_fit$n, empirical_trial_fit$n)

knitr::kable(
```

```{r edge-multiplicity, fig.width=11, fig.height=4}
edge_multiplicity_summary <- edge_multiplicity_comparison |>
  group_by(Data) |>
  summarise(
    Edges = sum(count),
```

# Density

## Unipartite

```{r density-unipartite, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
p_density <- make_metric_figure(
  "density", "Network density (Unipartite)", 0.05, FALSE, TRUE
)
p_density
show_parameters(metric_parameters("density", FALSE, TRUE, "Unipartite density"))
knitr::kable(metric_numerics("density"), digits = 3)
```

## Bipartite

```{r density-bipartite, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
p_bi_density <- make_metric_figure(
  "bi_density", "Network density (Bipartite)", 0.05, TRUE, TRUE
)
p_bi_density
show_parameters(metric_parameters("bi_density", TRUE, TRUE, "Bipartite density"))
knitr::kable(metric_numerics("bi_density"), digits = 3)
```

# Average path length

## Unipartite

```{r apl-unipartite, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
p_apl <- make_metric_figure(
  "avg_path_length", "Average path length (Unipartite)", 0.1, FALSE, FALSE
)
p_apl
show_parameters(metric_parameters(
  "avg_path_length", FALSE, FALSE, "Unipartite average path length"
))
knitr::kable(metric_numerics("avg_path_length"), digits = 3)
```

## Unipartite diameter

```{r diameter-unipartite, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
diameter_data <- comparison_data |>
  filter(is.finite(diameter), is.finite(avg_path_length))

p_diameter_bar <- ggplot(diameter_data, aes(factor(diameter), fill = Data)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge", colour = "grey15", linewidth = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = comparison_colors, name = "Data") +
  labs(x = "Diameter (Unipartite)", y = "Number of networks", title = "(a)")

p_diameter_apl <- ggplot(
  diameter_data,
  aes(avg_path_length, diameter, fill = Data, size = after_stat(n))
) +
  geom_count(shape = 21, colour = "grey15", alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = comparison_colors, name = "Data") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 8, name = "Count") +
  labs(
    x = "Average path length (Unipartite)",
    y = "Diameter (Unipartite)", title = "(b)"
  )

p_diameter <- p_diameter_bar + p_diameter_apl +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.18), guides = "collect")
p_diameter
knitr::kable(metric_numerics("diameter"), digits = 3)
```




# Clustering coefficient

## Unipartite

```{r clustering-unipartite, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
p_clustering <- make_metric_figure(
  "unipartite_c", "Clustering coefficient (Unipartite)", 0.05, FALSE, FALSE
)
p_clustering
show_parameters(metric_parameters(
  "unipartite_c", FALSE, FALSE, "Unipartite clustering coefficient"
))
knitr::kable(metric_numerics("unipartite_c"), digits = 3)
```

```{r clustering-predictor-regressions, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
p_clustering_density <- metric_scatter(
  "unipartite_c", "density", "Clustering coefficient (Unipartite)",
  "Network density (Unipartite)"
) + labs(title = "(a)")
p_clustering_irregularity <- metric_scatter(
  "unipartite_c", "deg_irreg", "Clustering coefficient (Unipartite)",
  "Degree irregularity (Unipartite)"
) + labs(title = "(b)")
p_clustering_predictors <- p_clustering_density + p_clustering_irregularity +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect")
p_clustering_predictors
show_parameters(fit_parameters(
  comparison_data, "unipartite_c",
  c("Unipartite density" = "density", "Unipartite degree irregularity" = "deg_irreg"),
  FALSE, "Unipartite clustering coefficient"
))
```

# Requested histogram panels

The following figures contain only the overlaid metric distributions for the
old database and empirical samples. They are displayed below.

```{r requested-histogram-panels, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
combine_histograms <- function(..., nrow = 1) {
  wrap_plots(..., nrow = nrow, guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}



p_old_density_histograms <- combine_histograms(
  metric_histogram(
    "density", "Network density (Unipartite)", 0.05
  ) + labs(title = "(a)"),
  metric_histogram(
    "bi_density", "Network density (Bipartite)", 0.05
  ) + labs(title = "(b)")
)

p_old_clustering_apl_histograms <- combine_histograms(
  metric_histogram(
    "unipartite_c", "Clustering coefficient (Unipartite)", 0.05
  ) + labs(title = "(a)"),
  metric_histogram(
    "avg_path_length", "Average path length (Unipartite)", 0.1
  ) + labs(title = "(b)")
)

p_old_assortativity_histograms <- combine_histograms(
  metric_histogram(
    "assortativity", "Degree assortativity (Unipartite)", 0.1
  ) + labs(title = "(a)"),
  metric_histogram(
    "bi_assortativity", "Degree assortativity (Bipartite)", 0.1
  ) + labs(title = "(b)")
)

p_old_irregularity_histograms <- combine_histograms(
  metric_histogram(
    "deg_irreg", "Degree irregularity (Unipartite)", 0.5
  ) + labs(title = "(a)"),
  metric_histogram(
    "bi_trial_deg_irreg", "Trial-degree irregularity (Bipartite)", 0.02
  ) + labs(title = "(b)"),
  metric_histogram(
    "bi_treatment_deg_irreg", "Treatment-degree irregularity (Bipartite)", 1
  ) + labs(title = "(c)")
)

p_old_MN_scatter <- ggplot() +
  geom_count(
    data = filter(comparison_data, Data == "2000-2019 Database"),
    aes(
      x = N_treatments, y = N_total_trials,
      fill = Data, size = after_stat(n)
    ),
    shape = 21, colour = "grey15", stroke = 0.35,
    alpha = comparison_alpha[["2000-2019 Database"]]
  ) +
  geom_count(
    data = filter(comparison_data, Data == "2023 Sample"),
    aes(
      x = N_treatments, y = N_total_trials,
      fill = Data, size = after_stat(n)
    ),
    shape = 21, colour = "grey15", stroke = 0.35,
    alpha = comparison_alpha[["2023 Sample"]]
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = comparison_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 8, name = "Count") +
  scale_x_log10(labels = plain_log_labels) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = plain_log_labels) +
  labs(
    title = "(c)", x = "Number of treatments (N)",
    y = "Number of trials (M)"
  )

p_old_MN_comparison <- combine_histograms(
  metric_histogram(
    "N_total_trials", "Number of trials (M)", 10
  ) + labs(title = "(a)"),
  metric_histogram(
    "N_treatments", "Number of treatments (N)", 2, boundary = 4
  ) + labs(title = "(b)"),
  p_old_MN_scatter
)




p_old_density_histograms
p_old_clustering_apl_histograms
p_old_assortativity_histograms
p_old_irregularity_histograms
p_old_MN_comparison

arms_summary <- comparison_data |>
  group_by(Data) |>
  summarise(
    Median = median(number_of_arms),
    Q1 = unname(quantile(number_of_arms, 0.25)),
    Q3 = unname(quantile(number_of_arms, 0.75)),
    IQR = IQR(number_of_arms),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(`Median (Q1–Q3)` = sprintf("%g (%g–%g)", Median, Q1, Q3)) |>
  select(Data, `Median (Q1–Q3)`, IQR)
knitr::kable(arms_summary, caption = "Number of arms per network: median and IQR")
```
